compiled_state.title: /dso:sprint auto-resume: .sprint-active not created on Phase-C resume entry -> session-merge-only enforcement inactive on resumed sprints
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (protection gap observed resuming epic 99f1-153c)

#### Expected Behavior
A resumed in_progress sprint should carry the same session-merge-only protection as a fresh sprint: .sprint-active present at the session-worktree root so check-session-merge-only.sh gates direct (non-merge) commits.

#### Actual Behavior
Resuming epic 99f1-153c via the auto-resume path (skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md routes an in_progress epic into Phase C, bypassing Phase A's '.sprint-active' creation block). On entry this session, .sprint-active was ABSENT (the prior session's graceful-shutdown / Phase I removes it, and auto-resume does not re-create it). Consequently check-session-merge-only.sh was inactive for the resumed sprint — direct non-merge commits to the session branch were not gated. No harm materialized this session (the relevant work routed through fix-bug + the staged channel), but resumed sprints run without the merge-only safety net. Fix: have auto-resume (or Phase C pre-batch) re-create .sprint-active for in_progress epic resumes. Open question to confirm in investigation: whether the marker was removed by the prior graceful-shutdown vs never created — either way the resume path should ensure it exists.

comments.body:
fix-bug:investigation

VERDICT: LIVE — bug confirmed unfixed as of HEAD bb39c4f334.

## Staleness Check
- Ticket created_at: 2026-06-02T18:21:01 UTC
- git log since then for auto-resume.md: zero commits touching the file
- grep for '.sprint-active' in auto-resume.md: NO MATCHES
- Bug is present and unpatched.

## Exact Location
File: plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md
Lines 55-57 (the Phase C routing):
  Line 55: '   5. After scan: if repo is clean, proceed to Phase C'
  Line 57: '   - Proceed to Phase C.'

The marker creation is absent at both Phase C entry points. The auto-resume path (section d) proceeds directly to Phase C without touching .sprint-active.

## Root Cause
Phase A of SKILL.md (line 157-158) creates the marker:
  touch "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"

Phase I (line 3110-3111) removes it:
  rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"

The auto-resume path (auto-resume.md) bypasses Phase A entirely and routes straight to Phase C. Since Phase I removes .sprint-active on graceful session close, a resumed sprint session starts without the marker → check-session-merge-only.sh hook is inactive → direct commits to session branch are ungated.

## Fix Approach
In plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md, add the touch command BEFORE 'Proceed to Phase C' in section (d). Exact insertion point: after line 55 ('After scan: if repo is clean, proceed to Phase C') and also after line 57 ('Proceed to Phase C.') — or consolidate into one block at the single final 'Proceed to Phase C.' on line 57.

Recommended: Add a labeled block just before 'Proceed to Phase C.' on line 57:

  ```bash
  # Re-create sprint-active marker (auto-resume path bypasses Phase A)
  touch "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"
  ```
  Then proceed to Phase C.

Mirror the exact command from SKILL.md line 158 verbatim: touch "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.sprint-active"

## RED Test Plan
Existing test (tests/hooks/test-sprint-skill-sprint-active-lifecycle.sh) only checks SKILL.md Phase A/I — does not cover auto-resume.md.

Recommended RED test (structural, execution-based):
  File: tests/hooks/test-sprint-auto-resume-sprint-active.sh
  Assert: auto-resume.md contains 'touch.*\.sprint-active' (grep -q)
  This will FAIL (RED) before the fix and PASS (GREEN) after.
  Pattern mirrors the existing lifecycle test Assertion 1.
  Non-behavioral rationale: auto-resume.md is LLM-executed skill prose, not a runnable script — structural grep is the correct behavioral-testing-standard approach for skill files per the 'structural skill test' category.
